name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
title: Bajaj Auto Ltd - 532977 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 with 20.8% EBITDA margin, but management flags 3.5–4% of revenue commodity inflation in Q1 with only ~40% priced back and motorcycle industry growth guided down to 7–9% from ~20%.

triggers.label: Commodity inflation 3.5–4% of revenue Q1
triggers.quote: we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue

triggers.label: Motorcycle growth 20% → 7–9% near term
triggers.quote: bound to slow down the mot orcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term

triggers.label: Chetak capacity expansion needed
triggers.quote: we have now reached a position where we think a substantive increase in capacity in Chetak is needed

triggers.label: Price hike covers ~40% of inflation
triggers.quote: we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far

triggers.label: Exports to 220k units per month
triggers.quote: pushing exports to the 220 K plus levels

guidance.quote: we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term
we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue
pushing exports to the 220 K plus levels
Sequentially, we look to hold margin flat

guidance.value: INR5,633 cr buyback plus INR4,192 cr final dividend
guidance.quote: a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores

red_flags.label: Q1 commodity shock 3.5–4% of revenue; pricing covers ~40%
red_flags.quote: we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far

red_flags.label: Demand softening and April volumes impaired 10–15% by supply constraints
red_flags.quote: impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%

red_flags.label: Unhedged FX; realising at market
red_flags.quote: we're not hedged, and therefore, we are realizing at market

evasions.topic: Full-year motorcycle growth and export vs domestic split
evasions.quote: how exactly the chips fall between exports and domestic motorcycles is difficult to say

evasions.topic: Price hike appetite and margin tolerance
evasions.quote: I think next round of pricing will probably be the last of the recourses that we will take, if at all required
